typography.font_strategy: Elegant light weights (300, 400) for large text, readable weights for tables. Generous spacing.

primary.hover: scale(1.03) with increased glow and shadow expansion

particle_system.movement: Organic, slow random drifting, flowing waves, digital rain (subtle)
particle_system.depth: Front (large, slight blur, fast), Middle (medium), Back (tiny, low opacity, slow)
particle_system.interaction: Radius 150px, particles gently move away, soft ripple
particle_system.mobile_degradation: Reduce particle count by 70%, disable backdrop blurs behind it if performance drops

components.effects: Fade in, slide up, scale, blur reveal, spring motion
components.hover: Cards lift (-translate-y-1), buttons glow, links underline smoothly

layout_and_spacing.sidebar: Fixed on the right side, glassmorphism applied
layout_and_spacing.tables: Dense gradebook tables must use zebra striping with rgba(255,255,255,0.02) and rgba(255,255,255,0.00) for readability, keep borders minimal
layout_and_spacing.mobile: Fast Evaluation Rubrics must be mobile-first, sticky action buttons at the bottom

icons.style: 2px stroke, rounded, consistent sizing, pure white or secondary text color, NO colorful icons

instructions_to_main_agent: DO NOT rebuild the website. Preserve all existing logic, routing, and state.
Add the new theme as a CSS class `.theme-lux` inside `index.css` or the main stylesheet, mapping to existing CSS variables.
Make `.theme-lux` the default theme in the theme provider/switcher context alongside the existing 20+ themes.
Create a new `ParticleBackground.js` component using Canvas API. Mount it inside `TeacherLayout` and `StudentLayout` (or internal routes), NOT on the root App if it affects login.
EXCLUDE the Teacher login page and Student join/login pages from this redesign completely. They must remain completely untouched.
Ensure the `html` or `body` tag retains `dir='rtl'` and layout uses `ms-` / `me-` (margin-start/end) or RTL specific Tailwind classes if rewriting any layout parts.
Add `@media print` rules to `index.css` to force pure white backgrounds, black text, and display:none for the particle system and sidebars, ensuring A4 rubric/gradebook printing works perfectly.
For the Fast Evaluation Rubrics (mobile-first), ensure the glass UI remains performant. If it lags, strip the backdrop-blur on mobile for those specific cards.
All interactive elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (kebab-case, role-based).
Apply Framer Motion selectively for page transitions and card entrances, keeping it buttery smooth (60fps).
